subject: MSA & Order Form redline + Ariba onboarding details
messages:
From: Sofia Bryant <sofia.bryant@healthex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@healthex.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + MSA redline questions for Healthex onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement is ready to start the portal enrollment but we have a couple of dependencies before we can complete Ariba vendor registration:

- We received your MSA but our legal team redlined Section 6 (Data Residency) and Section 9 (Indemnity). Can you confirm whether Redwood is willing to accept the proposed indemnity cap change?
- Ariba requires a PO acknowledgement flow. Do you accept an electronic PO acknowledgement via Ariba (997/855) or do you require paper-based PO acceptance?
- Portal fields: we need a canonical mapping from your Order Form to Ariba fields (Tax ID, remit address, PO acceptance SLA, EDI partner ID). Can you provide a crosswalk?

I can loop in our Ariba admin if it helps. We aim to have vendor ID and first test POs live by next week.

Regards,
Sofia Bryant
Sr. Procurement Manager
Healthex Solutions
[Attachment: Healthex_onboarding_questions.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Bryant <sofia.bryant@healthex.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + MSA redline questions for Healthex onboarding

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list. We’re aligned on the timeline and I’ve attached the items below to make the handoff smoother:

- redlined_MSA_2025-07-16.pdf (our legal team’s response; redlines are tracked)
- orderform_field_crosswalk_Healthex.xlsx (mapping of Redwood Order Form fields to Ariba/Po schema)
- portal_onboarding_notes.txt (practical notes for Ariba registration and test PO sequence)

Quick answers up front:
- Indemnity cap: legal has proposed a middle ground (see p.7 of the redline). We’re willing to accept the reduced cap if Healthex agrees to the standard limitation on consequential damages and to preserve Redwood’s data processing terms.
- PO acknowledgement: Redwood accepts Ariba electronic acknowledgements (997/855). Our ops team prefers the 855 acceptance flow for automated routing. If Healthex requires a manual acknowledgement, we can support that as an exception but it will add a step to PO processing.
- Field crosswalk: the attached spreadsheet maps the Order Form line items and required metadata to Ariba fields; the key asks from your side are Tax ID (EIN) and PO acceptance SLA (we default to 3 business days).

Next steps: can your team confirm whether the indemnity cap language from your redline is a hard requirement? Also please confirm the Ariba partner ID to include in EDI configuration.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a short handoff call for tomorrow if that works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redlined_MSA_2025-07-16.pdf; orderform_field_crosswalk_Healthex.xlsx; portal_onboarding_notes.txt]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MSA redline summary for Healthex (please advise)

Team — internal note before we send final back to Healthex. Quick summary of legal posture:

- Indemnity: Healthex is asking to remove Redwood's contractual cap. We are offering a compromise cap equal to aggregate fees in 12 months plus a carve-out for gross negligence and will not accept an unlimited exposure.
- Data residency: we can offer EU data-subset controls, but for Healthex (US customer) propose data processed in US with SOC2 controls; escalation needed only if the customer insists on EU-only residency.
- PO acknowledgement SLA: Ops prefers 855; legal fine with electronic ack as long as we include a clause that acceptance is not a waiver of invoice disputes.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm commercial acceptance of the proposed cap language (if they push, propose a phased limit tied to renewals).
- Jonas/Rachel: validate the crosswalk spreadsheet and confirm auto-routing for 855 -> Redwood ingestion.
- Mateo: prepare a short redline cover note with the exact paragraph changes we will send back.

Kimberly
VP, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Marissa,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the materials — the crosswalk is exactly what our integration team needed. A few updates from our side:

- Healthex counsel reviewed your counter-redline and the indemnity cap compromise is acceptable if we keep the carve-out for IP infringement. I’ll ask counsel for a one-line confirmation this afternoon.
- ProcureOne has provisioned vendor ID HXL-7782 for Redwood. Ariba admin (cc’d) will send the onboarding token and keystore details separately.
- For PO acks, ProcureOne supports both 855 and portal-ack; we’ll configure 855 where possible. Confirming Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789.

Next steps: if legal can send the final cover note and a clean MSA (ready-to-sign) we’ll route to our signatory. After signature we’ll kick off a test PO (test SKU provided in the spreadsheet).

Thanks — talk soon.

David Lee
Director, Vendor Enablement
Healthex Solutions
